source_scope: Six-stage temporal sparse regression specialization; independent bounded streaming SGD ensemble with fixed one-pass training.
implementation_origin: Independent project code; generated synthetic streams only.

stage_mapping.efficient_table_loading: Bounded JSONL reads and private immutable disk snapshots
stage_mapping.temporal_feature_engineering: Strict-past per-entity rolling/latest-time target means, age/count and periodic features
stage_mapping.categorical_sparse_encoding: Fixed-width unsigned entity/category hashing, eight numeric features and clipped CSR chunks
stage_mapping.leakage_safe_validation: Chronological train/validation/query gaps checked before fitting; frozen held-out history
stage_mapping.boosted_sparse_ensemble: One-pass squared-error and Huber sparse SGD on log1p targets with equal log-score mean
stage_mapping.metric_postprocessing: Clipped inverse transform, streamed RMSLE and bounded predictions

scope_corrections: Fixed one-pass optimization; no early stopping or validation-selected refit.
Specialization for nonnegative regression with immediately revealed historical targets; not every task named by the generic intake.
